Step 3. Applying the real interpolation theorem to \(R_{01290013}\), we obtain the norm bound in the mixed Lebesgue scale for the appropriate exponents.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via algebraic interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
